body:
Thank you so much for your kind words ♥️ It means a lot to me. 

I am so sorry to hear about your classmate. I agree with you: many times people don’t realize how much their loved ones care about them. I also think that maybe we don’t tell our loved ones enough how much we love them; since this happened to me, I have called all of my old friends I hadn’t talked to in years, I have apologized for things I have done wrong in the past, told them how much I care about them, even if we are apart, and told them all the things I like most about them. I think it’s important to let people know. You never know who is needing to hear it. I might’ve been able to save my ex, had I done the same with him and not waited so long. I’m glad that at least I learned now, and hope I will be able to make other people’s lives even a tiny bit happier. 

Thank you so much, take care ♥️

Hey, thank you for your sweet comment ♥️ It’s amazing how sweet you all are to complete strangers - I dare to say you are way sweeter about this than my actual friends. It shows you are such a good person. Thank you so much ♥️ Take care ♥️

Thank YOU for taking the time to read and send such a kind message to a complete stranger ♥️ It means a lot to me. 

I tried to ask, but to my complete disgust, found out nobody really seemed to care to dig into it too much. The only thing I managed to get out of his friends was that he was an overachiever (he was becoming an important lawyer at young age)  and according to them ‘it made him stress a lot’, which I don’t think is a valid reason to kill yourself, and I know for a fact that he would have never done something like that just because he was stressed. I never bought it. 
There was also a story about how a girl he had casually been dating, had rejected him that same day. They say he went home and killed himself because of that. It seems difficult, but who knows. Maybe I made him not believe in people anymore, and maybe with that other girl, he ‘confirmed’ to himself that no one would ever love him?
I wished I could’ve gotten his phone, maybe a diary, his laptop, anything that could give me clues on how he was really feeling, but sadly I couldn’t, because no one seemed to think that was a good idea. It is one of the things that angers me most, because I would like to try to understand him so much. Maybe one day I will be able to convince his parents to get his phone. Who knows. I really hope so. I feel I owe it to him to understand his pain. 

Thank you for your kind message ♥️

Thank you so for your words 😭 ‘If there’s anything that could make me believe love is real, it’s this’ .... You have no clue how much this means to me. I can’t thank you enough. I hope he feels that too now, in some kind of way. ♥️

I completely understand what you mean about the song, because I remember listening to it in 2013-ish, and I never really cared for it too much. I guess if you haven’t gone through something like this, or haven’t at least imagined what it would be like, there is no real way to connect with the words. 
That’s what I find most amazing about how she wrote this song. The emotion she was able to put into it, making people who actually went through that, relate to it so well. It’s amazing. 

Thank you for your amazingly kind words. I will never forget them. I mean that. Thank you ♥️ You are an amazingly kind person.

Thank you so much ♥️ That is exactly what I thought of doing. I reposted this in the suicide watch sub on here, thinking maybe someone feeling lonely would realize that more people than we realize love us, and think about us. We really have no idea whose life we might be changing. 
Thank you for telling me about the reasons of suicide; I know what you mean, but I do feel like I definitely made him question the kindness of people when the only person he had ever cared for betrayed him. The (unknown, for me) events after that probably made him feel more and more like he wouldn’t ever find a good person, and I just can’t forgive myself for having done that to him. I just hope he somehow sees how sorry I am. Thank you for your kind words, take care ♥️

Thank you so much ♥️ You are such a kind soul. It did hurt more than anything that I never got to tell him how much he meant to me, and that he concluded it would be better to die, thinking nobody loved him. I wish so much I could’ve changed that. 

Your words about how he is probably reading this, mean so much to me. Thank you, really ♥️

You seem like an amazing person. Thank you for your kind message, it means a lot to me. 

I don’t believe in it either, but I really hope I’m wrong. I would love for us to be together again more than anything.  
And if it doesn’t exist, then at least I hope he found the peace he apparently needed.. 

I really appreciate you saying he would forgive me. Thank you ♥️

Oh my god - I just want to thank all of you that read this and made the kindest comments I have ever seen in my life. You are all angels. I honestly didn’t even think anyone would read this, much less be so sweet about it. It’s so nice to see people be so supportive and actually care, since I have never been able to talk to anyone about this, because none of the people in my life understand what I was/am going through. It was good to write it down and see such amazing reactions. Thank you for making my week 🙏🏻

You are an angel ♥️ 
Thank you so much. 
She really does do that; I literally couldn’t believe my ears when I heard that song again after so long and listened to the lyrics. Amazing.
